description: Generated by autochip from protocol IR 'spc_single_cell_workflow' for chip chip1_encapsulation (Cells in core solution are pinched into shell-polymer droplets by fluorinated oil at a flow-focusing junction.). Flows, volumes and times the source did not give are placeholders.

steps.note: IR step 10 (droplets_1): encapsulate: FEED inlet_1 (cells_in_core_solution) at 2 uL/min, shell_polymer_in (shell_polymer) at 2 uL/min, fluorinated_oil_in (fluorinated_oil) at 10 uL/min, VENT outlet_1, all else capped.
